authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 374-334 (even side, 1902 and 1915), 2024-12-11 overcast strip. 374-364: six 3-axis houses of 5 storeys, plain brick with segmental heads, round-arched first-floor windows, one pediment dormer each (kinker-1890-plain-brick by eye; the cluster put most on kinker-1902-balcony-axis with NCC 0.25-0.31, but there is no balcony stack). 362-344: kinker-1902-balcony-axis (centre balcony stack, yellow brick courses), square dormers on 360-354 and bell or stepped gables on 352-344. 342-334 (1915): white-banded 2-axis modules with blocked heads (kinker-1890-brick-arched by eye; the cluster gave no type).
